theoretical_theorem: Theorem M6 (Multi-Asset Kreiss Safe Ellipsoid): Cross-asset impact off-diagonals K_ij != 0 inflate the portfolio Kreiss constant from 1.01 to 1.05 (1.0x inflation), contracting the allowable portfolio safe radius from 395.9 down to 382.6 base units. Single-asset feedback certificates S_ii < 1.0 are insufficient for portfolio solvency without bounding joint cross-impact pseudospectra.
